A '''wooden cross''' is a simple charm made of sticks and [[Estus Ash]] that gives {{G|Warding}} 1 while held. It is the cheapest [[warding]] item, and unlike the other warding items it stacks to 64.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The recipe unlocks together with the other [[Estus Ash]] recipes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/estus_ash.json}}</ref>

=== Archaeology ===
Wooden crosses can be brushed out of the graves at an [[Abbey]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/archaeology/abbey/grave.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
Held in the main hand or off hand, a wooden cross gives {{G|Warding}} 1: every second, undead mobs within 8 blocks get Slowness II and the nearest undead mob within 3 blocks takes {{Hp|1}} of damage that ignores armor. It never damages the [[Wither]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/warding/power_1.mcfunction}}</ref> Its warding adds to that of an item in the other hand, so a wooden cross in the off hand raises a [[Warding Sword]] to {{G|Warding}} 2 or a [[Nazar]] to {{G|Warding}} 3. See [[Warding]].

The wooden cross is built on a poisonous potato, but the pack removes its ability to be eaten.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/wooden_cross.json}}</ref>

== Advancements ==
The hidden advancement ''God help you...'' ("Commit great evil"), granted for killing a villager or wandering trader, uses the wooden cross as its icon.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/kill_villager.json}}</ref>
